text: The NDRRMP is notable for its explicit integration of DRR and CCA, aligning with the National Climate Change Action Plan (NCCAP) and the National Adaptation Plan (NAP). It employs a systems-based approach to improve institutional coherence and cross-sector collaboration. The plan is supported by a Results-Based Monitoring and Evaluation System (RBMES) to track progress and ensure accountability. A Midterm Review (MTR) is underway to assess progress and propose an Accelerated Disaster Action Plan (ADRAP) to enhance implementation.
